output.numerator: included releases with explicitly reported retrievable associated notes

denominator_rule: all accepted release-feed records; a ratio is observed only when every accepted release has an explicit retrieval outcome

params.retrieval_field: release_notes_retrievable boolean on each release record

confounders: captured release feeds may omit some or all note retrieval outcomes
the metric trusts the supplied retrieval outcome and does not fetch release notes itself
a retrievable note is not an assessment of note quality or completeness
status_note: v2 measures explicit per-release note retrieval outcomes; missing outcomes make the exact all-release denominator unavailable, while v1 remains repository-path presence
